card.title: Get It on the Record
card.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've approved the festival budget. Will you initial that before lunch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said yes to the fireworks last year too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. This year I'd like a dated yes to change from.

mechanism: A requires dated written budget approval so a later reversal cannot erase the original position.
confusable: Unlike seeking agreement alone, A must record a changeable yes as durable evidence.
comparison: A prior fireworks reversal motivates initials, while the fence example negotiates nonpermanent written consent.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
